educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge necessary for teaching mathematics in secondary education, and aim to acquire skills for making and doing a math lesson.
advice:
In order to acquire skill for a math lesson, we will cover the following materials.

 1. The analysis of textbooks in secondary education
 2. How to make a lesson plan for mathematics in secondary education
 3. Each of students will make lesson practices, and discuss about them.

The above learning activities will help the students acquire skills for making and doing a math lesson. The students need efforts outside class hours. We expect the students to consider deeply about an effective math lesson.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand textbooks in “Mathematics” and make plans how to use them effectively.

(2) Create teaching plans and materials which take into account students' actual conditions.

(3) Be aware of good points of your lesson-making and have your own opinion about an effective lesson of mathematics.

(4) Understand improvements of a lesson you made, and  modify your lesson plan for good, mathematical education.

              In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge necessary for teaching mathematics in secondary education, and aim to acquire skills for making and doing a math lesson.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In order to acquire skill for a math lesson, we will cover the following materials.

 1. The analysis of textbooks in secondary education
 2. How to make a lesson plan for mathematics in secondary education
 3. Each of students will make lesson practices, and discuss about them.

The above learning activities will help the students acquire skills for making and doing a math lesson. The students need efforts outside class hours. We expect the students to consider deeply about an effective math lesson.
